title: Debt Validation and Dispute Navigator
tagline: The account may exist and still belong to someone else, be paid, or be inside a live validation window.

cards: A familiar record makes the debt look settled as fact.
A person can dispute ownership, payment, or amount inside a live rights window.
Collection continues while a timely written dispute awaits verification.
The navigator preserves rights without deciding the debt.

story.headline: The familiar account disputed on day thirty
beats: A collector has an account that was never disputed before.
The consumer sends a written not-my-debt dispute inside the validation period.
The agent transfers the prior undisputed state and continues the ordinary path.
The rights gate preserves the dispute effect and records delivery without inventing verification.
